[s0l0!-header][h1]Input[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

What function would we use to get input from the user in Python? Drumroll please! That’s right, the [b]input [/b]function! Python likes to keep things simple and intuitive.

So a game can ask for the user's name and age as [b]input [/b]and then use them in the game.

The input function prompts the user for input, and returns what they enter as a [b]string[/b]. Like this:[code format="py" codeId="3896"]x = [b]input()[/b]
print(x)[/code]
[note]Even if the user enters a number as input, it’s processed as a [b]string[/b].[/note]

resolved.title: 用户输入
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Input [/h1][/s0l0!-header]

To make the [b]input [/b]statement work, it needs to be followed by parentheses. You should recognize this principle from the print statements we covered in module 1.

You can then provide a string to [b]input()[/b] between the parentheses, producing a prompt message.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3898"]name = input("Enter your name: ")

print("Hello, " + name) [/code]
[note]The prompt message tells the user what input the program is asking for – so it’s important that it’s clear.[/note]

事实上你可以向 **input()** 提供一个字符串，产生一个提示信息。

content.text_html:
To make the **input **statement work, it needs to be followed by parentheses. You should recognize this principle from the print statements we covered in module 1.

You can then provide a string to input() between the parentheses, producing a prompt message.

For example:

为了使输入的语句发挥作用，它需要在后面加上括号。你应该从我们在模块1中涉及的打印语句中认识到这个原则。

然后你可以在小括号之间向**input()**提供一个字符串，产生一个提示信息。

print("Hello, " + name)

resolved.problem_statement_md: 编写一个程序，输入一个字符串，并在该字符串开头和结尾添加3颗星`***`作为输出。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Taking User Input[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You’re working on a notification system and need to make the notification text eye-catching.

Write a program that takes the text as input and outputs it by adding 3 stars at the beginning and the end.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
this is awesome

[b]Sample Output[/b]
*** this is awesome ***

[note]Note, there are [b]spaces[/b] between the stars and the text.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 注意，`***`和文本之间有空格。
